review_text: Don't ever USE this app instead use Khalti, I had a massive amount of money in my account but I had to upgrade my phone, when I try to login from my new phone, it asks me for sms verification but guess what, it never sends, I know it isn't some network error or my mistake, that is simply eSewa fault, probably all my money is already taken and they aren't letting me login into my own account.
